topic: 过去进行时 (The Past Continuous Tense)
teaching_notes: 同学们，过去进行时（was/were + 动词ing）就像是拿一部摄像机，回放过去某个‘精准时刻’或‘特定时间段’正在发生的画面哦！主语是单数（I/he/she/it）用 was，复数（we/you/they）用 were。当表达‘一个动作正在进行时突然被另一个动作打断’，常搭配 when（后接一般过去时）或 while（后接过去进行时）。例如：I was reading a book when the phone rang.（我正在看书，这时电话响了。）/ While Mom was cooking, I was doing my homework.（当妈妈在做饭时，我正在做作业。）

questions.question: At 7:00 PM yesterday, my family and I ______ dinner together in the dining room.
questions.explanation: 句中包含了明确的过去特定时间点 'At 7:00 PM yesterday'，表示当时正在进行的动作，且主语 my family and I 为复数，故选 was/were + V-ing 形式的 were eating。

questions.question: While Sarah ______ in the garden, it suddenly started to rain.
questions.explanation: while 引导的时间状语从句通常接过去进行时，表示过去某段时间内持续发生的动作。Sarah 是第三人称单数，助动词用 was，故选 was playing。

questions.question: Tom was doing his homework when the lights ______ suddenly.
questions.explanation: 在 'was/were doing... when...' 结构中，when 引导的从句通常用一般过去时，表示突然发生的打断性动作。go out 的过去式是 went out。

questions.question:
— What ______ you doing at this time last Sunday?
— I was visiting my grandparents.
questions.explanation: 根据时间状语 'at this time last Sunday'（上周日这个时候）可知句型为过去进行时的特殊疑问句，主语是 you，助动词应填 were。

questions.question: While my mother was cooking dinner, my father ______ the living room.
questions.explanation: 用 while 连接两个动作时，常表示过去同一时间平行发生的两个持续性动作。前后两句均应用过去进行时，主语 my father 用 was cleaning。

questions.question: I called you three times last night, but nobody answered. What ______?
questions.explanation: 问句询问的是昨晚打电话那个特定时刻对方‘正在做什么’，因此要用过去进行时 were you doing。

questions.question: The students ______ quietly when the principal walked into the classroom.
questions.explanation: 校长走进教室（walked into，一般过去时）时，学生们‘正在安安静静地阅读’，主语 The students 是复数，故选用 were reading。

questions.question: My brother ______ to music with headphones, so he didn't hear the doorbell ring.
questions.explanation: 根据后半句 didn't hear（没听见）可知，弟弟当时‘正在戴着耳机听音乐’，背景动作处于进行中，故用过去进行时 was listening。

questions.question: Look at your wet shoes! What were you doing outside while it ______?
questions.explanation: while 从句表示‘当下雨（持续性动作）发生的时候’，且整件事发生在过去，应用过去进行时 was raining。

questions.question: Tim hurt his arm while he ______ football with his classmates.
questions.explanation: Tim 在‘正在踢足球’的过程中弄伤了手臂，while 引导的从句用过去进行时 was playing。

questions.question: ______ I was walking to school this morning, I saw a beautiful hot-air balloon.
questions.explanation: 句中从句部分 'I was walking to school' 是过去进行时，连接词应用 While，意为‘当……的时候’。

questions.question: Lucy ______ a lovely dream when her alarm clock rang at 6:30 AM.
questions.explanation: 闹钟响起（rang，一般过去时）的时候，Lucy 正在‘做美梦’，该持续动作被闹钟打断，主语 Lucy 搭配 was having。

questions.question: We ______ not watching TV at 9:00 last night; we were studying for the English test.
questions.explanation: 本题考查过去进行时的否定句结构：was/were + not + V-ing。主语是 We，助动词应用 were。

questions.question: Jack lost his key while he ______ through the crowded night market.
questions.explanation: Jack 丢钥匙发生在‘正在逛夜市’的背景动作之中，while 从句搭配过去进行时 was walking。

questions.question:
— Why didn't you answer my phone call at 8:00 PM?
— Sorry! I ______ a shower at that time.
questions.explanation: 根据问句中的 didn't 以及答句中的 at that time（那时），说明回答者当时‘正在洗澡’，主语 I 搭配过去进行时 was taking。
